H8601.d: from אָפָה; cookery, i.e. (concretely) a cake; baked piece.

H8566.d: a primitive root; to present (a mercenary inducement), i.e. bargain with (a harlot); hire.

H8656.d: from רָצָה; delightsomeness; Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess; Tirzah.

H8553.d: from מָנָה; a portion assigned; Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine; Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.

H8636.d: from רָבָה; multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal; increase, unjust gain.

H8658.d: probably of foreign derivation (compare תַּרְשִׁישׁ); a gem, perhaps the topaz; beryl.

H8546.d: from מוּת; execution (as a doom); death, die.

H8664.d: patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead); Tishbite.

H8646.d: of uncertain derivation; Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert; Tarah, Terah.

H8661.d: of foreign derivation; Tartan, an Assyrian; Tartan.

H8539.d: a primitive root; to be in consternation; be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

H8662.d: of foreign derivation; Tartak, a deity of the Avvites; Tartak.

H8504.d: probably for שְׁחֶלֶת; the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith; blue.

H8574.d: from נִיר; a fire-pot; furnace, oven.

H8525.d: from an unused root meaning to accumulate; a bank or terrace; furrow, ridge.

H8536.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁם; there; [idiom] thence, there, [idiom] where.

H8669.d: from שׁוּק in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing; desire.

H8594.d: from עָרַב; suretyship, i.e. (concretely) a pledge; [phrase] hostage.

H8560.d: from the same root as תָּמָר; a palm trunk; palm tree.

H8583.d: or תֹּעִי; from תָּעָה; error; Tou or Toi, a Syrian king; Toi, Tou.

H8651.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׁעַר; a door; by implication, a palace; gate mouth.

H8674.d: of foreign derivation; Tattenai, a Persian; Tatnai.

H8641.d: or תְּרֻמָה; (Deuteronomy 12:11), from רוּם; a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute; gift, heave offering (shoulder), oblation, offered(-ing).

H8618.d: from קוּם; an opponent; rise up against.

H8612.d: the same as תֹּפֶת; Topheth, a place near Jerusalem; Tophet, Topheth.

H8564.d: from the same root as תָּמָר; an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board); high heap.

H8535.d: from תָּמַם; complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear; coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.

H8549.d: from תָּמַם; entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth; without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.

H8533.d: (Aramaic) multiple of תְּלָת; ten times three; thirty.

H8609.d: a primitive root; to sew; (women that) sew (together).

H8567.d: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of attributing honor); to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate, commemorate; lament, rehearse.

H8597.d: or תִּפְאֶרֶת; from פָּאַר; ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively); beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

H8558.d: from an unused root meaning to be erect; a palm tree; palm (tree).

H8619.d: from תָּקַע (in the musical sense); a trumpet; trumpet.

H8587.d: from עָלַם; a secret; thing that is hid, secret.

H8544.d: or תְּמֻנָה; from מִין; something portioned (i.e. fashioned) out, as ashape, i.e. (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor); image, likeness, similitude.

H8639.d: from רָדַם; a lethargy or (by implication) trance; deep sleep.

H8584.d: from עוּד; attestation, i.e. a precept, usage; testimony.

H8571.d: perhaps from the same as אֲנָךְ through the idea of protraction; a pinnacle, i.e. extremity; tip.

H8505.d: a primitive root; to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test); bear up, direct, be (un-)equal, mete, ponder, tell, weigh.

H8552.d: a primitive root; to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive; accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, [idiom] be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

H8547.d: of uncertain derivation; Temach, one of the Nethinim; Tamah, Thamah.

H8614.d: (Aramaic) perhaps from שָׁפַט; judicial, i.e. a lawyer; sheriff.

H8501.d: from an unused root meaning; to dissever, i.e. crush; deceitful.

H8648.d: (Aramaic) feminine תַּרְתֵּין; corresponding to שְׁנַיִם; two; second, [phrase] twelve, two.

H8635.d: from רָבָה; multiplication, i.e. progeny; increase.

H8611.d: from the base of תָּפַף; a smiting, i.e. (figuratively) contempt; tabret.

H8622.d: or תְּקֻפָה; from נָקַף; a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse; circuit, come about, end.

H8599.d: the same as תַּפּוּחַ; Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite; Tappuah.

H8647.d: of uncertain derivation; Tirchanah, an Israelite; Tirhanah.

H8617.d: from קוּם; resistfulness; power to stand.

H8665.d: from שָׁבַץ; checkered stuff (as reticulated); broidered.

H8591.d: a primitive root; to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat; deceive, misuse.

H8507.d: the same as תֹּכֶן; Token, a place in Palestine; Tochen.

H8520.d: probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach; Telach, an Israelite; Telah.

H8667.d: from שׂוּם; a deposit, i.e. pledging; [phrase] fellowship.

H8515.d: or תְּלַשַּׂר; of foreign derivation; Telassar, a region of Assyria; Telassar.

H8568.d: probably feminine of תַּן; a female jackal; dragon.

H8631.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּקַף; to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate; make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.

H8637.d: a denominative from רָגַל; to cause to walk; teach to go.

H8557.d: from מָסָה; liquefaction, i.e. disappearance; melt.

H8660.d: of foreign derivation; Tirshatha, the title of a Persian deputy or governor; Tirshatha.

H8577.d: or תַּנִּים; (Ezekiel 29:3), intensive from the same as תַּן; a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal; dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

H8629.d: from תָּקַע; a blast of a trumpet; sound.

H8500.d: or תּוּכִּי; probably of foreign derivation; some imported creature, probably a peacock; peacock.

H8506.d: from תָּכַן; a fixed quantity; measure, tale.

H8573.d: from נוּף; a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings; offering, shaking, wave (offering).

H8509.d: apparently from an unused root meaning to encompass; a wrapper or robe; garment.

H8508.d: from תֹּכֶן; admeasurement, i.e. consummation; pattern, sum.

H8672.d: or (masculine) תִּשְׁעָה; perhaps from שָׁעָה through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ordinal) ninth; nine ([phrase] -teen, [phrase] -teenth, -th).

H8670.d: from שׁוּר in the sense of arrival; a gift; present.

H8545.d: from מוּר; barter, compensation; (ex-) change(-ing), recompense, restitution.

H8603.d: from the same as תָּפֵל; quagmire; Tophel, a place near the Desert; Tophel.

H8593.d: from עָרָה; a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty); (pen-) knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.

H8569.d: from נוּא; alienation; by implication, enmity; breach of promise, occasion.

H8626.d: a primitive root; to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose; set in order, make straight.

H8554.d: patrial from תִּמְנָה; a Timnite or inhabitant of Timnah; Timnite.

H8630.d: a primitive root; to overpower; prevail (against).

H8512.d: from תֵּל and אָבִיב; mound of green growth; Tel-Abib, a place in Chaldaea; Tel-abib.

H8642.d: formed as תְּרוּמָה; a sacrificial offering; oblation.

H8640.d: of foreign derivation; Tirhakah, a king of Kush; Tirhakah.

H8510.d: by contraction from תָּלַל; a mound; heap, [idiom] strength.

H8521.d: from תֵּל and the feminine of חֲרָשִׁים; mound of workmanship; Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylonia; Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.

H8605.d: from פָּלַל; intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn; prayer.

H8602.d: from an unused root meaning to smear; plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity; foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.

H8607.d: from פָּסַח; ford; Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia; Tipsah.

H8579.d: (Aramaic) from תִּנְיָן; a second time; again.

H8523.d: (Aramaic) or תַּלְתִּי; (Aramaic), ordinal from תְּלָת; third; third.
